releases.summary: Independent TAG500 baseline.
Initial data-safety and Sharia research-only separation.
Temporal first-seen, persistence and gain-retention instrumentation.
Stricter Sharia presentation and research-only gating.
Runtime identity and audit presentation cleanup.
Runtime consolidation and removal of temporal overlay dependency.
Stable /tag500/ entrypoint without threshold changes.

20-minute Freshness Gate; VERIFIED-only executive ranking; UNVERIFIED Research Only; Final Snapshot Reconciliation plus >=2 independent sources required for training eligibility. No threshold changes.
Persistence Slope, Gain Retention and Late-RVOL Guard added from repeated intraday snapshots; no threshold change.
Temporal trajectory promoted into the decision UI: accelerating/building/stable/fading, first-seen time and delta from first seen. No scoring threshold changes or unverified performance claims.
Live-data routing fixed: TAG500 now reads workflow-refreshed market data from main first, with published-branch fallback and explicit data-origin audit. No threshold changes.

Central Signal-Origin Gate: pipeline first-observed timestamp and change are now shown and used to block Discovery credit when the stock was already >=20% at first observation. No threshold retune or unverified performance claim.

Origin Confirmation: combines central first-seen with temporal persistence/gain retention to label early-confirmed, early-pending, early-fading, or late-origin. No core threshold retune or unverified performance claim.

Actionability-first ranking: A confirmed-early, B pending, C fading, late/blocked tiers. Top Opportunity can no longer be dominated by late-origin high-score stocks. No core threshold retune or performance claim.

Catalyst Clock: compares latest-news time with central first signal; post-signal news triggers Catalyst Attribution Error, verified no-news becomes No-News Momentum Path, and catalyst timing only breaks ties inside A/B. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Catalyst Timeline fix: scans the full available news timeline, preserving a valid pre-signal catalyst even when newer post-signal news exists; Attribution Error is only raised when available news is post-signal only. No threshold retune or performance claim.
Visibility-aware auto-refresh every two minutes, live snapshot-age monitoring, focus/return refresh, and overlapping-request protection. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Refresh Health Gate: tracks last attempt, last successful refresh, consecutive failures, snapshot age and active data source; stale or failed refresh state is shown explicitly instead of silently appearing live. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Executive-first UX: default table view now shows only VERIFIED actionability A/B opportunities; Research Mode exposes late, blocked and unverified cases for audit without presenting them as executable opportunities. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Session-aware Final Close UX: distinguishes intraperiod snapshots from the post-8:00 ET final after-hours close candidate, stops treating final-session data as ordinary stale intraperiod data, and keeps training fail-closed until Final Snapshot Reconciliation from >=2 independent sources. No threshold retune or performance claim.
